data.content_ref: inline:Change the skeptical semantics from a least fixed point of a monotone operator to the unique model of a nonmonotone logic program with explicit defeat rules, and prove that this model coincides with the grounded extension on acyclic attack graphs but differs on cycles by treating odd-length cycles as refuting all members and even-length cycles as suspending all. This makes odd cycles refuted rather than suspended, retaining determinism and polynomial cost via stratification, but it abandons standard reinstatement on cyclic graphs, so it is a deliberate trade-off.
